project_type: React 18 + TypeScript SPA (Vite), new project under web/ in a Flutter/Python monorepo
build_system: Vite 5 — build command is `npm run build`, dev server is `npm run dev`. All source under web/src/. No existing web/ directory; scaffold from scratch.
test_framework: None mandated for this build; use `npm run build` (TypeScript compile) as the verification gate for every feature.
verification_instructions: 1. cd into web/. 2. Run `npm install` if node_modules absent. 3. Run `npm run build`. Zero TypeScript errors = pass. Optionally `npm run dev` for manual smoke-test against real backend.
environment_constraints: Windows host (PowerShell). web/ does not exist yet — must be created. Do NOT touch backend/ or lib/ (Flutter). Backend CORS is open (`allow_origins=['*']`) so no proxy needed in dev. Use Cognito id_token (not access_token) as Bearer — backend validate_claims checks `aud` for id tokens.
contribution_requirements: All colors from colors.ts tokens, never hard-coded hex. Dark theme throughout. AI calls are server-side only — never call Bedrock from the React app. AI-suggested reminders require user confirmation before POSTing to /reminders (R1.9).
key_patterns: Feature-first directory layout: src/features/<domain>/. Shared UI in src/components/ui/. Types in src/types/index.ts. API services in src/features/<domain>/<domain>Api.ts. Auth via AuthContext (React Context + amazon-cognito-identity-js). Server state via @tanstack/react-query. Token: id_token from Cognito attached via axios request interceptor.
directory_structure: web/ — entire new React app. web/src/features/<domain>/ per domain (auth, reminders, events, capture, memory, dashboard, settings, ai). web/src/components/ for shared Layout + UI primitives. web/src/lib/ for apiClient.ts, cognitoClient.ts, colors.ts. web/src/types/index.ts for all TS interfaces.
